## 75c10ce4046c

**Reproduced defect: canonical five-cell shape support is absent.**  Current
source SHA-256 is
`dc078b431000a0385a36ecffb1290815f61a1abd2bc5995f03c62fb77dc8dd13`.
Across 900 generated inputs (300 per difficulty band), all 900 source components
and all 4,231 candidates had exactly four cells.  The canonical test instead uses
a five-cell source and five-cell candidates.  Applying the canonical Racket rule
to that exact pentomino input returned `[[0,8,0,8]]`, so the omitted domain is
accepted by the authority rather than invalid.  Evidence:
`checks/audit/75c10ce4046c/generator_domain_probe.json`,
`checks/audit/75c10ce4046c/pentomino_input.json`, and
`checks/audit/75c10ce4046c/racket.json`.

A secondary exact-control defect also reproduced: 40 draws requesting
`matching_candidates=3` produced match counts `{1:17, 2:9, 3:9, 4:4, 5:1}`.
The axis is advertised but not consumed by `generate`.  This was an audit-only
target; no source was changed.

## 75c10ce4046c

**Reproduced defect: canonical object-size support is missing.**  The selected
generator's `_SHAPES` table contains five four-cell signatures.  Across 900
sampled inputs (300 per band), every source had exactly four cells and all 4,230
candidate components had exactly four cells.  The canonical data is broader:
the second training pair contains five-cell candidates, and the test pair uses a
five-cell source plus three five-cell candidates.  A learner can therefore rely
on a tetromino-only domain and never see the size-independent congruence behavior
needed by the canonical test.

A constructed legal pentomino scene was sent through the canonical Racket rule;
it returned the expected indicator `[8, 0, 8, 0]`, confirming that the authority
supports this omitted domain rather than rejecting it.  Evidence:
`checks/audit/75c10ce4046c/probe.json`,
`checks/audit/75c10ce4046c/racket_pentomino_input.json`, and
`checks/audit/75c10ce4046c/racket_pentomino_output.json`.

**Secondary reproduced control defect.**  `AXES` advertises
`matching_candidates`, but `generate` chooses `match_count` directly from the
layout RNG.  Forty draws requesting `matching_candidates=3` produced observed
match counts `{1:13, 2:10, 3:11, 4:5, 5:1}`.  The control is not exact or even
consistently bounded by its advertised maximum.  No fix was made because this
was a findings-only audit.
